brief_description: PicoSoC SPI-flash model testbench from picorv32's picosoc/. Exercises tri-state IO, x-state propagation through the SPI bus model, and `$display`-driven status messages alongside the trace. Built locally: iverilog -s testbench -o spiflash_tb.vvp spiflash.v spiflash_tb.v && vvp -N spiflash_tb.vvp. Distinct from picorv32_ez_testbench in covering bus-side X states and tri-state IO assignments.
anchors: child scope `testbench.uut` is the spiflash model
value stream contains x and z bits (tri-state IO) alongside concrete 0/1 transitions
